title: rcac-bioinformatics/mitoforge pipeline parameters
description: Assemble, circularise and annotate animal mitochondrial genomes from PacBio HiFi or Illumina paired-end reads.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Where the pipeline finds your samples and where it writes the results.

input.description: Path to the samplesheet CSV describing your samples.
input.help_text: A comma-separated file with the header row `sample,platform,fastq_1,fastq_2,bam,species,ref_fa,ref_gb,genetic_code`. Every column is documented at https://rcac-bioinformatics.github.io/mitoforge/samplesheet/

outdir.description: Directory where the results will be written.

multiqc_title.description: Title to print at the top of the MultiQC report.

reference_options.title: Reference mitogenome options
reference_options.description: How the close-relative reference mitogenome is chosen for each sample.

genetic_code.description: NCBI translation table used for annotation when the samplesheet does not give one.
genetic_code.help_text: 2 = vertebrate mitochondrial (default), 5 = invertebrate mitochondrial, 9 = echinoderm and flatworm mitochondrial. A `genetic_code` value in the samplesheet always wins over this parameter.

min_ref_length.description: Minimum length of a candidate reference mitogenome fetched from NCBI by species name.
min_ref_length.help_text: Passed to MitoHiFi's findMitoReference.py as `--min_length`. Raise it if the search keeps returning partial mitogenomes.

assembly_options.title: Assembly options
assembly_options.description: Which assembler runs on each platform, and how it is tuned.

long_assembler.help_text: Only `mitohifi` is available in v1. The parameter exists so that another long-read assembler can be added without changing the samplesheet format.

short_assembler.help_text: Only `getorganelle` is available in v1. The parameter exists so that another short-read assembler can be added without changing the samplesheet format.

mitohifi_percent_id.description: MitoHiFi `-p`: percentage of a contig that must match the reference mitogenome for the contig to be kept.
mitohifi_percent_id.help_text: Leave unset to use the MitoHiFi default (50). Lowering it helps when the only available reference is distant; raising it helps when NUMTs are being picked up. See the troubleshooting page.

skip_trimming.description: Skip fastp adapter and quality trimming of Illumina reads.

annotation_options.title: Annotation options
annotation_options.description: The standalone ANNOTATE stage. Not implemented in v1.

skip_annotation.help_text: ANNOTATE is a stub in v1: it passes assemblies through unchanged. Every sample is still annotated inside the FINALIZE step by MitoHiFi. See docs/developer/extending.md.

cluster_account.description: SLURM account to charge jobs to. Run `slist` on a Gautschi login node to see yours.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options, typically set in a config file.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).

custom_config_version.description: Git branch/tag/commit of nf-core/configs to take institutional profiles from.

custom_config_base.description: Base path or URL for the nf-core/configs institutional profiles.
custom_config_base.help_text: This provides -profile purdue_gautschi. Set NXF_OFFLINE=true, or point this at a local checkout, to avoid fetching it at launch.
